title: Status Monitor Deux
description: Monitor hardware statistics in real time.
author: masagrator
details:
Status Monitor Deux displays real-time hardware statistics such as per-core CPU usage, GPU load, CPU/GPU/RAM frequencies, memory usage, temperatures, and fan behavior through an overlay interface.

It uses customizable `.smd` script files for its display modes and `.smse` extension files for additional services, giving you much more control over how information is presented.

Its configuration, modes, extensions, and localization files are stored under `sd:/config/status-monitor-deux`.
